ModMetadata.Name: Stationeers UI Ascended
ModMetadata.Author: FlorpyDorp
ModMetadata.Description:
Radial interaction, smart storage, and a modern visor HUD for Stationeers.
Hold Middle Mouse for a toolbelt radial, hold R for tool controls and slot swapping, press G for profile-aware Smart Stow, and enjoy a clean two-hand visor HUD - no ten-slot hotbar, ever.
This is a Plugin Mod. It requires BepInEx with the StationeersLaunchPad plugin.
Client-side only: all inventory actions go through the game's own server-authoritative logic, so it is safe on any multiplayer server.
ModMetadata.InGameDescription: Stationeers UI Ascended (SSUI) Radials, radials, radials - but only where they support the physical two-hand logic of Stationeers. * Toolbelt radial - hold Middle Mouse, flick, release to equip * Tool radial - hold R: toggle, mode, and slot swaps for the held tool * Slot finder - swap in a battery from anywhere in your inventory, even inside another tool * SmartStow+ - G stacks into partial stacks and profile-assigned bags first * Bag profiles - per-bag item/category rules, shareable as XML * Visor HUD - two-hand boxes, slim status strip, compact vitals, hardcore gating Client-side and multiplayer-safe: every item move uses the game's own authoritative logic.
ModMetadata.ChangeLog: 0.1.0: Initial proof-of-concept release. Toolbelt radial, tool radial, slot swap discovery, SmartStow+, bag profiles, visor HUD overlay, nested bag radial.
